answer: Resist sybils with reputation futures: each identity weight is priced by a staking market where traders bet on its future honest conduct, risking their own funds. A trellis of standing grows only where the market, putting money behind its judgment, prices it high. Sybils start worthless: to lift ten thousand fakes, an attacker must buy their reputation itself, paying hard market prices per fake, and the fable of free identities dies when every name needs a buyer. Fakes pool in a thread of low bids, their weight near zero until someone pays real money to vouch for them.
